app.title: Show HN: HackerTV – HN's most-recommended Youtube videos as 24/7 TV channels
app.author: dsalzman
app.description: A streaming service that aggregates and plays YouTube videos based on Hacker News top posts.
proposed_tests: Verify that the page loads within 3 seconds
Check that the API fetches the top 50 HN stories correctly
Measure stream start latency for 5 different videos
Confirm that the channel updates every 5 minutes
